title: Throatlatch
description: A growling FM bass-lead that sits in the low-mid and slowly tears itself apart: over 24 cycles the distortion, FM index and bitcrush all climb on separate clocks while a screaming ladder-filter envelope sharpens, so a controlled snarl degrades into a full-throated scream before the loop resets.
code:
setcpm(138/4)
stack(
  note("<e2 e2 [g2 e2] <b2 d3>>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .fm(sine.slow(17).range(2, 12)).fmh("<1 1.5 2 0.5>/4")
    .penv("<0 4 -3 7>/8").pattack(0.002).pdecay(0.07)
    .vib("<5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 1.1))
    .lpf(sine.slow(29).range(420, 3600)).resonance(sine.slow(19).range(10, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(saw.slow(24).range(2, 7)).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.16)
    .distort(saw.slow(24).range(0.05, 1.1))
    .crush(saw.slow(23).range(16, 5))
    .shape(sine.slow(11).range(0.28, 0.7))
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.2).sustain(0.55).release(0.06)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.16, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.24).pan(0.75).crush(6))
    .room(0.14).postgain(0.88).gain(0.9)
)
